title:
Epic that removes loading state from search bars in derived props grids.

This epic monitors actions with loading payloads and automatically sets the search
loading state to false for the specified component. It is specifically designed
to handle search bar loading states in grids that display derived properties.

Behavior:
- Filters actions that have a loading payload set to true
- Extracts the componentId from the action payload
- Dispatches a {@link UiSdlSearchable#setSearchLoadingAction} to turn off the loading state

Usage:
This epic is typically used in scenarios where search functionality in derived
props grids needs to have its loading state automatically cleared after certain
actions complete, ensuring a smooth user experience.

@see UiSdlEpic
name: RemoveLoadingFromSearchBarWithDerivedPropsGridEpic
